purpose: Publish the machine-readable file provenance register in docs/ip/ and bind the generated JSON to the exact source SHA it describes, without reclassifying any file as first-party.
requiredInvariants: The register must stay conservative: UNKNOWN origin must never be rewritten as first-party to improve a statistic.
CSV and JSON must contain the same number of records, and that number must equal the tracked file count of the authority base tree.
The generated JSON must record the exact source SHA it was produced from.
The CSV must remain deterministically reproducible from the same tree and history.
No product code, UI, authentication, database, migration, dependency, lockfile, workflow or production configuration may change.
Merge and CI success are not REG.RU production deployment evidence.
No new recurring cost is introduced.
acceptance: docs/ip/FILE_PROVENANCE.csv and docs/ip/FILE_PROVENANCE.json both exist and hold 6175 records each.
The CSV header is exactly the sixteen fields required by the IP programme.
UNKNOWN origin remains 6146 and CROWN_JEWEL unresolved origin remains 605 - the remainder is recorded, not closed.
The first-party IP policy tests still pass 15/15.
The concurrent-scope guard accepts exactly the four authorized paths.
